name: Achsah
bio: Achsah was the daughter of Caleb. Caleb promised that whoever captured the city of Kiriath Sepher (Debir) would receive Achsah as his wife; Caleb's younger brother Othniel took the city and married her (Joshua 15:16-17). As she was leaving to be married, Achsah urged Othniel to ask her father for a field, then dismounted her donkey and asked Caleb directly for "a blessing," saying, "Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs (Joshua 15:18-19). This account of Achsah actively securing property and water rights for herself and her husband offers a vivid glimpse of her decisive, resourceful character.
